newsitem.title: USA: Village Green says will merge with CD co.
newsitem.headline: Village Green says will merge with CD co.

text.p: The Village Green Bookstore Inc said Friday it has agreed to merge into a subsidiary of CD Titles Inc.
The company said the new corporation created as a result of the merger plans to issue and sell $5 million of its common stock to the public.
The agreement in principle is subject to the customary contingencies, including due diligence by the parties, Shareholder approval and market factors.
The company said that upon execution of a definitive agreement, it plans to submit the proposed merger to its shareholders for approval.
